theme: 3 terms for scrolling in SwiftUI: the bar, the jump helper and the visible position

terms.definition: The thin bar that appears at the edge of a scroll view while the user scrolls.
terms.example: Hide the Scroll Indicator, because the design has no bar.

terms.definition: A container that gives you a proxy, so you can scroll to any view that has an id.
terms.example: Wrap the list in a ScrollViewReader to build a jump to top button.

terms.definition: A modifier that binds the id of the visible view, so you can read and change where the scroll view is.
terms.example: Save the Scroll Position, so the feed opens where the user stopped.

video.title: Scroll Indicator, ScrollViewReader & Scroll Position | Day 153
video.description:
Learn to explain how scrolling works in SwiftUI: Scroll Indicator, ScrollViewReader & Scroll Position, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
Scroll Indicator - The thin bar that appears at the edge of a scroll view while the user scrolls.
ScrollViewReader - A container that gives you a proxy, so you can scroll to any view that has an id.
Scroll Position - A modifier that binds the id of the visible view, so you can read and change where the scroll view is.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

landscape.title: SwiftUI Scroll Indicator, ScrollViewReader & Scroll Position | Day 153
landscape.description:
Explain Scroll Indicator, ScrollViewReader & Scroll Position in SwiftUI by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.
스크롤 인디케이터, 스크롤뷰리더, 스크롤 포지션 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

Scroll Indicator - The thin bar that appears at the edge of a scroll view while the user scrolls.
한국어: 스크롤 인디케이터: 사용자가 스크롤할 때 스크롤 뷰 가장자리에 나타나는 얇은 막대

ScrollViewReader - A container that gives you a proxy, so you can scroll to any view that has an id.
한국어: 스크롤뷰리더: id가 있는 어떤 뷰로든 스크롤할 수 있게 프록시를 주는 컨테이너

Scroll Position - A modifier that binds the id of the visible view, so you can read and change where the scroll view is.
한국어: 스크롤 포지션: 보이는 뷰의 id를 바인딩해서 스크롤 뷰의 현재 위치를 읽고 바꿀 수 있게 하는 수정자

In this video, Mina and Jake hide the scroll bar and add a jump to top button, in a chat-style conversation, with the Swift code on screen.

landscape.hook: Can you explain Scroll Indicator, ScrollViewReader and Scroll Position in English?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, my feed shows a scroll bar on the right, and the design does not have it.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Hide the Scroll Indicator. Add `.scrollIndicators(.hidden)` to the `ScrollView`.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Done. The Scroll Indicator is gone.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Now I need a button that jumps back to the top.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Wrap the content in a ScrollViewReader. It gives you a proxy, and the proxy can scroll to any view with an id.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Can the ScrollViewReader also tell me where I am now?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: No. For that, use Scroll Position.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: You bind the `id` of the visible view. When the user scrolls, the Scroll Position changes.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: And if I change the `id` in code?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then the list scrolls to that view. Give each row its own `id`.
